words.gloss: theoretical or bookish knowledge of doing a task
even if one has thoroughly mastered

literal: Theoretical knowledge even if known, the world's practical nature having understood, act.
translation: Even if you have thoroughly mastered the theoretical methods of performing a task, you must understand the practical ways of the world and act accordingly.
modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்யும் முறைகளை நூலறிவால் அறிந்திருந்தாலும், உலக நடைமுறையை அறிந்து அதற்கேற்பச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the difference between theoretical knowledge and practical wisdom. The word 'செயற்கை' refers to artificial or bookish knowledge, which details the technical steps of a task. Even if a person has mastered these theories ('அறிந்தக் கடைத்தும்'), they cannot succeed without understanding 'உலகத்து இயற்கை', which refers to the natural, practical ways of the world and human behavior. A wise minister or leader must harmonize bookish rules with real-world conditions before taking action.
